messages:
Olga: Heads-up — legal flagged a customer ask for longer immutable audit retention (they want 7 years) and formal evidence export APIs. Need roadmap alignment.
Kevin: 7 years is pretty heavy for hosted customers. Is the ask raw payloads or hashes?
Olga: they said raw audit trails: auth events, admin actions, model input hashes + timestamps. PII can be redacted but legal prefers raw for eDiscovery.
Sam: redaction + eDiscovery are at odds. If they need raw inputs, we must surface BYOK or escrow options.
Maya: for SOC2 evidence, auditor wants signed manifests + tamper-evident storage. We should define an "evidence export" artifact format.
Jordan: propose minimal launch criteria: 1) export API v1 (S3 manifest + signatures), 2) retention policy UI + tenant TTL, 3) BYOK handshake for export keys, 4) legal signoff for hosted SLA.
Olga: timeline: legal wants pilot in Q3 for a large customer. Can we hit that?
Sam: infra rough: 8w export infra + 4w KMS integration + 2w compliance review. Q3 pilot might be doable if prioritized.
Kevin: also need cost model. Storing 7 years of audit for an active enterprise = index + cold storage. We should offer Glacier-style cold tier + query index.
Maya: question for product: do we allow raw input retention in hosted by default? privacy risk. Recommend opt-in with contractual clause.
Olga: agreed. Hosted default: hashed inputs + metadata. Raw inputs available behind contract + BYOK.
legal-bot: @Olga created ticket FIN-452: "Evidence export SLA playbook" — https://tickets/FIN-452
Jordan: ops ask: rollout path -> dedicated tenant / single-customer first, then enable per-tenant option in hosted. Canary to 1 customer.
Sam: technical note: seven-year search implies maintaining an index or generating manifests on export. My recommendation: keep minimal index (event keys + timestamps) and store blobs in cold S3 bucket (Glacier Deep Archive) with periodic manifests.
Kevin: cost sketch: assume 500GB/month * 84 months ~ 42TB; Glacier DA cost estimate ~ $X/month (will fill exact). We'll attach numbers to FIN-452 for sales.
Maya: add SOC2 checklist: retention matrix per region, chain-of-custody docs, signed manifests, KMS audit logs.
Olga: decision: form small working group: Olga, Kevin, Maya, Sam, Jordan. Deliver proposal + cost model + launch criteria in 2w.
Sam: I'll draft infra spec + export schema. Quick example payload for export request:
```
POST /v1/exports
{
  "customer_id": "cust-123",
  "start": "2024-01-01",
  "end": "2024-12-31",
  "types": ["auth", "admin", "model_inputs"],
  "kms": {
    "byok": true,
    "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd"
  },
  "delivery": {
    "s3_bucket": "s3://customer-exports",
    "signed_manifest": true
  }
}
```
Kevin: include retention TTL configs per tenant and an API to mark data as legal-hold.
Maya: also include region compliance: EU customers may need data residency and different retention opt-ins.
Olga: can someone sync with sales/legal before Monday? They have a customer call then.
Maya: I'll join the call Monday 10am PT.
Sam: adding a launch checklist item: "legal signoff on BYOK export terms".
Jordan: added to FIN-452.
Olga: thanks all — meeting invite sent. We'll reconvene after the pilot scoping call.
